note: RFC 1661 Section 5.7: "If the LCP automaton is in the Opened state, then this MUST be reported back to the peer by transmitting a Protocol-Reject." Rejudged statically at HEAD; the body is unchanged. TestRFC1661UnsupportedProtocolRejectedInOpened goes red unless one LCP code-8 frame names the received protocol. TestRFC1661UnsupportedProtocolNotRejectedBeforeOpened requires zero frames outside Opened, matching the same section: "Protocol-Reject packets can only be sent in the LCP Opened state." The mutant record on the handleFrame fall-through is semantic; the negative record is a producer panic showing reachability only, and removing the Opened gate goes red by reading.
